description: Nineteen unique searches are preserved in this derived V2 log, including Arabic/English protest and strike terms, Nov 1–15 and 16–30 windows, Muscat/Sohar/Salalah, labor, student, Palestine, local news and official-news searches. Accessible results yielded dated ordinary policy/ceremony coverage, older 2011/2021 labor protests, and one April 2024 article describing three strike notices as not implemented. No Q4 public gathering with a documented demand on Oman’s state/policy and verified simultaneous attendance of at least 50 was identified. V1 line 17 is preserved unchanged; V2 separates its two captured records after independently checking them against preserved raw responses. A captured union-magazine November 2024 archive query lists several labor-policy pieces but its snippet is not a full archive read and does not establish absence of a protest.
required_followup: Continue independent contemporary reporting, union/civil-society coverage, sector-specific and governorate searches, and adjacent-month onset/continuity checks; do not treat search silence or unimplemented strike notices as evidence of no event.
